children: "The thing I'm most worried about right now is actually bioterrorism."

-Moderna CEO Stéphane Bancel, speaking about the risks that AI poses at Journal House yesterday. He said he sees a scenario in which a bad actor uses AI to build a respiratory virus cheaply as having "a very high probability of happening."
